exposure: Clustering of non-natives of different nationalities in urban areas
cohort: The study cohort consisted of native and non-native women receiving medical care within the Italian tax-funded universal National Health Service.
finding: While no significant differences were found in C-sections or inappropriate C-sections between natives and non-natives overall, significant disparities existed between different groups of immigrants, primarily driven by linguistic and socio-cultural distances affecting communication and information processing.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in C-sections or inappropriate C-sections between natives and non-natives, but significant differences in C-section rates and appropriateness were observed among different immigrant groups, linked to linguistic and socio-cultural barriers.
